# Andrew Yip — UX/UI Designer & Developer

> Andrew Yip is a UX/UI designer and developer based in Vancouver, BC, Canada.
> Originally from Hong Kong, he completed a postgraduate program in Web and Mobile App Design & Development at Langara College before building his career in British Columbia.
> He specialises in product design, design systems, landing pages, and front-end development for SaaS and enterprise companies.
> Available for freelance projects and full-time roles.

## Languages

This site is available in English (default, no path prefix) and Traditional Chinese (`/ch/` prefix). Every page listed below — including all 4 case studies — has a Traditional Chinese counterpart at the same path under `/ch/` (e.g. https://andrewthyip.com/ch/about/, https://andrewthyip.com/ch/work/yocale/).

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://andrewthyip.com/): Bilingual entry gate — a split-screen chooser routing visitors to either the hiring/portfolio track (`/portfolio/`) or the "get a website built" services track (`/services/`)
- [Portfolio & Work](https://andrewthyip.com/portfolio/): Overview of all case studies and client work
- [Services](https://andrewthyip.com/services/): Services offered, process/workflow, client work examples, and testimonials — for businesses looking to have a website designed and built
- [Services · Work](https://andrewthyip.com/services/work/): Same case studies as the Portfolio page, presented for the Services-page audience
- [Services · About](https://andrewthyip.com/services/about/): Same background, philosophy, and career timeline as the About page, for the Services-page audience
- [Services · Contact](https://andrewthyip.com/services/contact/): Same contact form as the Contact page, for the Services-page audience
- [About Andrew Yip](https://andrewthyip.com/about/): Background, work philosophy, career timeline, skills, and testimonials
- [Contact](https://andrewthyip.com/contact/): Contact form for project inquiries, freelance work, and full-time opportunities
- [Yocale Case Study](https://andrewthyip.com/work/yocale/): GTM design system — 5.15% CTR lift, 40% bounce rate reduction, 22.5% download lift
- [Delta Controls Case Study](https://andrewthyip.com/work/delta/): Enterprise intranet redesign — navigation reduced from 4–6 clicks to 2–3 clicks, 15% engagement increase
- [Ant Equipment Group Case Study](https://andrewthyip.com/work/ant/): Brand and web design — 1,000+ monthly visitors, 80% engagement lift
- [Crowd Ease Case Study](https://andrewthyip.com/work/crowd-ease/): Capstone Award-winning restaurant and event management mobile app (Langara College 2023, selected by audience vote)
- [Yocale 個案研究 (Traditional Chinese)](https://andrewthyip.com/ch/work/yocale/), [Delta Controls 個案研究](https://andrewthyip.com/ch/work/delta/), [Ant Equipment Group 個案研究](https://andrewthyip.com/ch/work/ant/), [Crowd Ease 個案研究](https://andrewthyip.com/ch/work/crowd-ease/): Traditional Chinese counterparts of the 4 case studies above

## Key Facts

- **Name:** Andrew Yip
- **Location:** Vancouver, BC, Canada
- **Role:** UX/UI Designer & Developer
- **Specialisms:** Product design, design systems, landing page design, UX research, front-end development (Astro, Webflow, WordPress), Figma
- **Tools:** Figma, Webflow, WordPress, Astro, Ahrefs, GSAP, Claude
- **Languages spoken:** English, Mandarin, Cantonese, Spanish
- **Clients:** Yocale (SaaS, booking & scheduling platform), Delta Controls (enterprise building automation), Ant Equipment Group (equipment rental & sales, western Canada), Khachak Studio, Rosemary Diamond, Blu Bathworks, RKW Communications
- **Education:** Langara College — Web and Mobile App Design & Development
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrewthyip/

- **Open for:** Freelance UX/UI design and development projects, and full-time roles in Vancouver, BC
